crm_notes:
Summary: Mid-market product company building in-app assistant + semantic search. Started on Hosted to gate risk and iterate. After 6-week POC they want Dedicated for predictable latency and cost controls.

Key technical requirements:
- Workloads: conversational chat for end-users (high concurrency), embeddings for search index + reranking for suggestions.
- Targets: p95 latency <150ms for chat tail in prod; sustained throughput ~200 req/s; burst up to 500 req/s for promotions.
- Model preferences: prefer Redwood-curated Llama2-Chat or equivalent; fallback to smaller quantized variant for low-priority jobs to save cost.
- Routing: need canary/dev/prod pools; rollout policy (canary 10% traffic -> 25% -> 100%).
- Data/security: VPC peering, KMS-managed keys, SOC2 required, retention controls for transcripts, EU residency for subset of PII.

Commercial ask / negotiation points:
- Committed vs burst: customer wants a 12-month commit with quarterly ramp (50% of final commit in Q1, 75% in Q2, 100% by Q3). Seeking discounted committed rate in exchange for fixed monthly GPU-hours and defined burst buffer.
- Overage model: prefer tiered overage caps (e.g., first 20% over commit billed at 1.2x, beyond billed at 1.5x) instead of per-token at list price.
- Ramp credits: ask for credit windows while they ramp traffic to Dedicated; sample ask: first 2 months of ramp billed at 50% of committed rate.
- Evaluation success metrics: <150ms p95, cost per 1M tokens <= $X (internal target), no production incidents in 30 days when under full traffic.

Stated quotes from calls: "We like how fast Hosted got us to signal, but predictability for our customers is the reason we'll move to Dedicated." — Head of Platform.

Action items:
- SE (Diego) to provide Dedicated sizing options (vCPU/GPU hours mapping) + sample canary rollout configs by 2026-03-08.
eng_notes: POC notes: Hosted POC run used mixed batch micro-batching, KV cache enabled; saw token-level cost variability during peak search indexing. Dedicated ask: guarantee of cache warmup behavior and ability to pin model versions. Need explicit SLA on cold-starts and KV cache persistence across scaled pods.
commercial_notes: Pricing history: initial handshake pricing in Jan included 20% discount on hosted volume if they convert to Dedicated within 90 days. New negotiation centers on committed monthly GPU-hours vs token pricing. Customer proposed ARR band $180k-$350k depending on final commit. Finance asking for conversion clause and 6-month exit terms.
